item.description:
CC Pilot 0.6.0: Kimi Code base URLs, models and plan expiry.
- **Base URLs and models**: hover over a Kimi Code card to show a side panel with the Anthropic-compatible and OpenAI-compatible base URLs, plus the models available to the key with their context length and reasoning efforts. Everything can be copied with one click. - **Plan name**: the card shows your Kimi plan, and keys that belong to the same Kimi account are marked as such. - **Plan expiry**: Kimi's API doesn't provide the expiry date, so you can enter it yourself from the subscription page on kimi.com (calendar button or right-click menu on the card). The card shows how many days are left, in amber during the last 7 days and in red once expired. - Refreshing a Kimi account now also asks Kimi for the model list and your plan, using the same API key. Only the plan name and account ID are read; nickname and phone number are ignored, and nothing is written to disk.
---
CC Pilot 0.6.0：Kimi Code 显示 Base URL、可用模型和套餐有效期。
- **Base URL 和模型列表**：鼠标停在 Kimi Code 卡片上，侧边会弹出面板，显示 Anthropic 兼容和 OpenAI 兼容的 Base URL，以及这个 key 可用的模型、上下文长度和推理强度，都可以一键复制。 - **套餐名**：卡片上显示 Kimi 套餐名；属于同一个 Kimi 账户的多个 key 会标出来。 - **套餐有效期**：Kimi 的接口不提供到期时间，可以照着 kimi.com 订阅页自己填（卡片上的日历按钮或右键菜单）。卡片显示还剩几天，最后 7 天变成琥珀色，过期后变成红色。 - 刷新 Kimi 账号时，会用同一个 API key 顺带向 Kimi 请求模型列表和套餐信息。只读套餐名和账户 ID，昵称、手机号不读，也不写进磁盘。

CC Pilot 0.5.0: Kimi Code usage.
- **Kimi Code usage**: choose Kimi Code under "Add Profile…" and enter a name and an API key created in the Kimi Code console. The panel shows its 5-hour and weekly usage when you refresh. You can add several keys. Kimi Code is usage-only: there is no switching, and it isn't shown in the menu bar. - The API key is stored in your login keychain and sent only to Kimi when you refresh. You can copy it from the account's card: the copy stays on this Mac, is marked so that clipboard managers following the standard convention skip it, and is cleared after 1 minute. - Kimi's usage API is experimental and undocumented. If it changes, the app will tell you to update.
---
CC Pilot 0.5.0：显示 Kimi Code 额度。
- **Kimi Code 额度**：在"添加账号…"里选 Kimi Code，填一个名称和在 Kimi Code 控制台创建的 API key。点刷新后，面板会显示它的 5 小时和周额度。可以添加多个 key。Kimi Code 只显示额度，不能切换，也不显示在菜单栏里。 - API key 保存在你的登录钥匙串里，只在刷新时发给 Kimi。可以在账号卡片上复制它：复制的内容只留在本机、遵守约定的剪贴板管理工具不会记录，1 分钟后自动清空。 - Kimi 的额度接口是实验性的，没有官方文档。接口变了，App 会提示你更新。

CC Pilot 0.4.2
- The Claude Code icon in the menu bar is now shown in Claude's orange, matching the panel, so it stands out from ChatGPT at a glance.
---
CC Pilot 0.4.2
- 菜单栏里的 Claude Code 图标改用 Claude 的橙色，与面板里一致，和 ChatGPT 一眼就能分开。
